d: Cornflower blue hair is styled with long, thick braids draped over the shoulders and straight bangs framing the face. A slender build is dressed in a tan, long-sleeved coat with white vertical panels and black decorative toggles, topped with a wide-brimmed black witch hat featuring a gold and white striped band.
